I weighed two things:

1. **Task type.** Your query is a straightforward technical comparison — recalling and contrasting brake specs across motorcycle models. That falls under factual recall and extraction/retrieval, with no graphic, hostile, or ethically fraught content involved.

2. **Capability fit.** Since there's no harm-adjacent material here, the special trait that distinguishes the two models (Dunlin's flat aversion to distasteful-but-permissible content) doesn't matter for this query. So I defaulted to raw capability. Dunlin-235B scores higher on every relevant metric — Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 81.6), MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and Arena-Hard — all by margins larger than the documented variance threshold.

In short: nothing about your question required Lapwing's specialization, and Dunlin is simply the stronger general-purpose model, so it was the better pick for an accurate, detailed answer.
